subject: english
question: Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence: The manager **has been dismissed on charges to accept bribes.**

options.text: has been dismissed on charges for accepting bribes
has been dismissed on charges of accepting bribes
had been dismissed on charges of bribing

solution:
The correct answer is '**has been dismissed on charges of accepting bribes**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The phrase **"charges of accepting bribes"** is grammatically correct and commonly used to describe such situations.
 
• **Option 1**, **"charges for accepting bribes,"** is incorrect because "charges for" is not the proper collocation in this context.
 
• **Option 3**, **"was dismissed for accepting bribes,"** changes the tense and does not align with the original sentence structure.
 
• **Option 4**, **"had been dismissed on charges of bribing,"** alters the meaning and incorrectly implies that the manager was bribing others.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"The manager has been dismissed on charges of accepting bribes."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Incorrect due to the improper use of "charges for."
 
• **Option 3:** Incorrect because it changes the tense unnecessarily.
 
• **Option 4:** Incorrect because it changes the meaning and implies the manager was the one bribing others.
